name: Solar District Cooling Group Berhad
overview: 今年公司完成凭单红利发行及雇员认股计划，并录得季度营收与净利润同比增长；公告中未披露各业务板块的具体扩张、缩减或新合约事项。
overview_en: During the year, the Company completed a bonus issue of warrants and an employees' share option scheme, and recorded year-on-year growth in quarterly revenue and net profit; the announcements did not disclose specific expansion, reduction, or new contract events for individual business segments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成凭单红利发行及雇员认股计划，未披露各业务板块的具体运营变化。
segments.note_en: Completed a bonus issue of warrants and an employees' share option scheme this year; no specific operational changes for individual business segments were disclosed.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 211,911,224张凭单于2026年8月10日完成在ACE Market上市及报价。
actions.text_en: 211,911,224 warrants were completed listing and quotation on the ACE Market on 10 August 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 凭单行使价固定为RM0.8200，凭单契约于2026年7月17日签署。
actions.text_en: The exercise price of the warrants was fixed at RM0.8200, and the deed poll was executed on 17 July 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 雇员认股计划于2026年5月21日生效。
actions.text_en: The employees' share option scheme became effective on 21 May 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 于2026年2月13日批准凭单红利发行及雇员认股计划。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved the bonus issue of warrants and employees' share option scheme on 13 February 2026.
